name: IBY_VAL_ASSIGNMENTS_
description: IBY_VAL_ASSIGNMENTS links validation sets to the appropriate validation entity. Through this table, individual validation sets are assigned to the payment method, payment format, or other entity that requires the validation encoded in that validation set. Payment method validation sets are those that should be evaluated as soon as possible once a transaction is assigned a payment method. Since each transaction is required to have a payment method assigned, these validations are evaluated immediately upon submission to Oracle Payments. All other types of validations are done offline, once the appropriate format or other entity has been assigned to the transaction. The determination of what type of entity a validation set should be associated with is based on the deploying company's business rules, the rules of the countries that have jurisdiction over the transaction, and ease-of-use. Typically, validations should be performed as early as possible, so users have immediate feedback and opportunity to modify invalid transactions.

columns.name: VALIDATION_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: FIELD_NAME_CODE
columns.description: Field name lookup code of user-defined validation. This column can be null for predefined validation.

columns.name: VALIDATION_SET_CODE
columns.description: Validation set code

columns.name: VAL_ASSIGNMENT_ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of entity to which this validation is assigned. Values, from the lookup IBY_VALIDATION_ASSIGN_ENTITIES, include METHOD, FORMAT, BANK, TRANSPROTOCOL, and INTBANKACCOUNT

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the appropriate entity, for example, payment method, payment format.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Inactive date

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TERRITORY_CODE
columns.description: Country to which the validation is applicable

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment method to which the validation is applicable

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the assignment of a validation set to the payment method or format becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the assignment of a validation set to the payment method or format becomes inactive.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
